answer:
The maximum is 16,000 dimensions. The reference section says: "Vectors can have up to 16,000 dimensions." [pgvector/README.md]

This matches the changelog entry for 0.4.0: "Increased max dimensions for vector from 1024 to 16000" [pgvector/CHANGELOG.md].

The limit for indexing is lower. The README says "Other options are..." and that half-precision vectors can index up to 4,000 dimensions: "You can use half-precision vectors or half-precision indexing to index up to 4,000 dimensions" [pgvector/README.md]. The context does not state the index limit for the standard `vector` type, but the changelog says the max dimensions for an index was increased from 1024 to 2000 in 0.4.0 [pgvector/CHANGELOG.md].
